purpose: Responsive Many Birds One Stone main-menu backgrounds without baked-in text or controls

landscape.prompt: Create a finished premium illustrated MAIN MENU BACKGROUND for Many Birds One Stone, a cheerful children's draw-a-path physics puzzle. Use image 1 as the style/character reference (three charming blue birds, golden stone, wooden and brass claw, polished glossy cartoon finish); image 2 supplies its sunlit woodland setting and calm turquoise/leaf-green palette. This is a background adaptation, NOT a repeat of the icon. No text, no lettering, no logos, no buttons, no user interface or frames anywhere. Wide landscape 3:2 composition, approximately 1536 by 1024. Build a magical sunlit woodland overlook: arching leafy branches at the sides, warm shafts of light through layered emerald/turquoise forest, soft distant hills and a glimmering stream, flowers and mossy stones in the foreground. Three distinct lively friendly blue birds with orange beaks and warm bellies fly or perch around the middle third, one larger bird on the left, a second on the right, a smaller one near the upper middle, with clean expressive eyes and anatomically coherent cartoon wings. A small well crafted wooden and brass drop claw holding exactly one glowing golden spherical stone hangs from an upper branch on the right side; a subtle luminous curved path arcs through the clearing to hint at drawing. The birds and claw are charming focal accents, not clutter. Preserve a calm bright central sky/glade behind the top-center game title area and clear low-detail darker space near bottom center for two real HTML mode buttons. Main scene must still look beautiful when a narrow phone crops to the central 40 percent: place some foliage, the small bird and clear sky within that central column; keep the important outer birds inside the center 80 percent. Layered painterly environment with crisply finished glossy cartoon birds and brass, coherent warm upper-right lighting, rich natural green and turquoise with tiny violet flowers tying to the icon, no photorealism, no flat vector look, no oversaturated neon, no human characters. Full bleed, no white margins. This should feel like a polished real game title-screen environment, with generous quiet space for readable interface.

portrait.prompt: Recompose this exact woodland main-menu artwork into a polished tall portrait mobile background, 2:3 aspect ratio, approximately 1024 by 1536. Preserve the same glossy blue-and-orange birds, natural woodland palette, coherent sunlit painterly environment, gold ball and wooden/brass claw. This is the portrait companion to the landscape image, not a new visual direction. Do not crop a bird's face or wings at the side edges. Fit three whole birds comfortably within the middle 80% of the portrait width in the UPPER HALF: one fairly large flying bird near the left of upper-middle, another medium bird on the right slightly lower, one small bird above them; warm golden stone in a small claw at the upper right, completely readable inside the edges. Frame with leafy trees and violet flowers and distant layered turquoise mountains/stream. Keep the lower 38 percent low-detail calm woodland/grass with enough darker green space for a real HTML game title and two large mode buttons; do not draw that title or buttons. No words, letters, logos, signs, UI, borders or white margin. All important bird silhouettes stay within frame with generous breathing room. Maintain a clean cheerful professional family game main menu, bright cyan sky and soft warm sunlight, exact scene family of the input image.
